verdict.rationale: The published guidance pages on www.sos.ca.gov (bizfile overview, forms, information requests, service options) were retrieved as readable text. Probes against that host returned ordinary 404s rather than a bot wall or CAPTCHA, which suggests the guidance surface is reachable by a keyless agent. The adjacent bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov portal, however, serves an Incapsula bot-management SPA shell even for robots.txt, so the interactive search and records surface is walled. Missing for 10: an explicit HTTP 200 probe of a guidance page under an identified user agent confirming no JS-only shell, and keyless access to the bizfile portal's public search and copy surface.
